data_facts_with_para.paragraph: ['Chinese electric vehicle (EV) maker BYD has reported annual revenue for 2024 that hasexceeded U.S. rival Tesla.', "BBC News reports that the Shenzhen-based EV carmaker reported on March 25 that 2024 revenue rose by 29%, to 777 billion yuan ($107 billion), compared to the $97.7 billion reported by Elon Musk's Tesla.", "BYD sold around the same number of EVs as Tesla last year – 1.76 million compared to 1.79 million, respectively. But when sales of the Chinese company's hybrid cars are taken into account it is much bigger, selling a record 4.3 million vehicles globally in 2024."]

facts.fact_content: BYD's 2024 revenue is 777 billion yuan ($107 billion).
BYD sold 4.3 million vehicles globally in 2024.
